summary: Frontend-only verification of landing-page 8-point ecosystem clarity refactor + dashboard slideshow WebP regeneration. 51/52 targeted assertions passed. critical_code_review_comments: Landing.jsx is large (>1900 lines). Consider extracting SituationPicker, ThreeReportsStrip, NotAVerdictStatement, EcosystemFlow into separate files under /components for maintainability.
Console shows repeated 401 errors on landing page network calls (guest/prefetch endpoints). Not user-visible but should be investigated to reduce noise.
